Minor P3 wording notes, not defects: (1) gates/constraints/prompt.md:'Do not open a job, move, reject or message anything here' uses 'open a job' in the product's create-a-requisition sense (rules section 2 'Only recruiters open jobs'; app_context.md:27), while gates/render/prompt.md uses 'open' in the navigate sense ('do not open any conversation'); the constraints criterion itself says 'Do not grade job opening' and explicitly directs adding a card in the Data Analyst job, so the intended reading is recoverable. (2) polish prompt.md:24 'A workable order: open a job and add three cards' while hro_pol_live_board may require adding cards up to twelve until the board scrolls; the order is advisory and the criterion governs. (3) hro_job_open requires a team value while protocol S names only manager and places; the judge must supply a team, which the criterion's 'title, team, hiring manager and interview places' makes clear. Tried counterexamples: a broken app cannot exploit any prompt inaccuracy because no prompt asserts a wrong seed fact, account or screen; a conforming alternative could only be failed by a judge misreading note (1) as 'do not navigate into a job', which the same criterion's explicit Data Analyst instruction contradicts.
